what: The Tip Calculator works out the tip on a bill and the total to pay, and splits it between any number of people. Type the bill, choose a tip percent and the number of people, and you see the tip, the total, what each person pays and the tip per person.
It is useful at restaurants, cafes, taxis, salons and anywhere you add a tip. Quick buttons for 10%, 15%, 18%, 20% and 25% make it fast to choose a common amount.
Everything runs in your browser, so it works quickly on your phone at the table. Results are estimates and not financial advice.
uses: Find the tip and total for your bill in a few seconds.
Divide the total, including tip, evenly between friends.
Tap different percent buttons to see how the total changes.
Use it for taxis, delivery, hair salons and other services.
Some receipts print suggested tips; check them quickly.
tutorial: Type the bill in "Bill amount", for example 64.50. Nothing is shown until the bill is above 0.
Type a percent in "Tip (%)" or tap one of the buttons "10%", "15%", "18%", "20%" or "25%". The default is 15. You can type any value, such as 12.5.
Type how many people share the bill in "Split between (people)". The default is 1. Decimals are rounded down to a whole number.
"Tip" is the tip amount, "Total" is bill plus tip, "Each person pays" is the total divided by the people, and "Tip per person" is each person’s share of the tip.
features: Tip = bill × tip percent ÷ 100. Total = bill + tip.
Each person pays = total ÷ number of people; tip per person = tip ÷ number of people.
Type any tip percent, including decimals.
Results change as soon as you change a number.

example.title: Worked example: 64.50 split three ways
example.text: Three friends have a dinner bill of 64.50 and want to tip 18%. Type 64.50, tap "18%" and set people to 3. The tip is 64.50 × 18 ÷ 100 = 11.61, and the "Total" is 76.11. "Each person pays" 25.37 and the "Tip per person" is 3.87. Because of rounding, three payments of 25.37 add up to 76.11.

tips: Decide whether to tip on the amount before or after tax, and enter that amount as the bill.
Round "Each person pays" up to make paying in cash easier.
The results are rounded to 2 decimals, so when splitting, the shares may differ from the total by a cent.
If some people ordered much more, an even split may not be fair; work out their shares separately.
Check if a service charge is already on the bill before you add a tip.
problems: The split shows the wrong number of people
Decimals are rounded down and the minimum is 1. Type a whole number such as 4.
Negative percents are treated as 0. Type a tip of 0 or more.
The percent button did not change my custom value
The buttons replace whatever is in "Tip (%)". Type your custom value again if you need it.
